body:
Review pass 16. C6 closed - independently verified, everything claimed holds. Epic 5 now in flight; metric.R was hot so I stayed off it.

DETERMINISM, your stated proof target. n=150, p=64, two partitions, searchlight radius 2.1, across a 256x workspace range:
  16 MiB / 64 MiB / 512 MiB / 4096 MiB -> bitwise identical values AND identical signatures, all four.
The budget really does alter cache capacity only.

CORRECTNESS against an independent base-R oracle (qr.resid then crossprod, no package code):
  run1  310 pairs  max|package - oracle| = 8.53e-14
  run2  310 pairs  max|package - oracle| = 1.14e-13
On cross-products of magnitude 100-140 that is ~1e-15 relative - floating-point exact. residual_df = 145 = n - rank on both partitions.

PAIR SET is exactly the union co-occurrence pattern: 310 requested, 310 upper-triangular nonzeros in the Epic 1 support index, every requested pair inside the pattern.

The padded/unpadded hazard from last pass is handled - .accumulate_residual_pair_partition reads through .residual_padded_block exclusively, LRU tile cache sized by budget. Fixed shape, varying count.

BUDGET REFUSAL works and is informative: 1 KB is rejected with "Canonical residual pair accumulation requires at least 88984 bytes, exceeding the 1024-byte workspace budget"; zero is rejected. Before any source read, as you claimed.

No new findings this pass - nothing is wrong, and I would rather say that than manufacture something.

Still open, unchanged: bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D (recommended for closure), bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8 (scale gates never run), bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50 (measurement-kernel preflight allocates what it sizes), bd-01KZXJMDRC6VKYX6SA38R0AAH1 (subtraction receipt), bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED (uncommitted tree).
